text: Bombardier Inc. has issued Class A shares carrying 10 votes per share and Class B subordinate voting shares carrying one vote per share. As at 3 March 2025 the four family 'Principal Shareholders' (Janine Bombardier, Claire Bombardier Beaudoin, Huguette Bombardier Fontaine, J.R. André Bombardier) held 80.80% of the Class A shares, 1.38% of the Class B shares and 47.83% of all voting rights.
short: The Bombardier family Principal Shareholders hold 80.80% of Bombardier Inc.'s 10-vote Class A shares (47.83% of total voting rights).

source.name: Bombardier – Shares & dividends (Wayback Machine capture of 5 August 2026)
source.quote: 9,977,978 Class A shares and 1,208,449 Class B subordinate voting shares, representing in the aggregate 80.80% of the issued and outstanding Class A shares
source.note: Footnote 2 under the share table names the four family members collectively as the 'Principal Shareholders'; the live bombardier.com page serves a JavaScript shell to scripts.
